name: project-seele-builder
description: Research visual references, build safe staged Minecraft reconstructions, and inspect them through Project SEELE MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Reference-driven Minecraft architecture with visual QA.
interface.longDescription: Searches exterior and interior references, derives a Minecraft-scale blueprint, uses Project SEELE's protected preview/execute workflow, captures rendered views, and applies scoped visual corrections.
defaultPrompt: Research and build a landmark near me, then inspect it from several views.
Create a source-backed Minecraft blueprint before constructing this building.
Capture my current build view and propose a scoped visual correction batch.
